player_question: Why is the shallow water beautiful and still hostile?
truth_payload: Photic mats make oxygen, color and food, but they also reveal how quickly pressure ecology turns route safety into a local condition.
replay_axis: Mat density and safe-pocket hints can vary by seed without changing ecology rules.

player_question: How does harmless fauna teach danger?
truth_payload: Glass grazers are not threats; their sudden silence, schooling direction and bite marks teach predator telegraph and route risk.
replay_axis: Grazers can alter predator warning timing by seed.

truth_payload: Lantern drifts can mark oxygen and food, but storm charge and industrial residue make them false beacons.
replay_axis: False-safe glow frequency can vary by storm-window seed.

player_question: How does ecology become a route ladder?
truth_payload: Brine vanes grow where density shear is stable; reading them lets the player infer survivable canyon steps.
replay_axis: Vane forest density can vary canyon route readability.

player_question: When does an animal become infrastructure?
truth_payload: Atlas-tagged fauna are still animals, but old sensor tags, biofilm and route impulses make them maintenance carriers.
replay_axis: Tagged fauna can carry different signal trails by seed and depth.
